name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 10, 2011
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Pastor Matthew Palm of the Hope Church of the Nazarene
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring May 2011, National Bike Month and May 20, 2011, National Bike to Work Day in the City of Vista
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for the Month Ending March 31, 2011 (CC)
C4.
Appropriation of Funds for the Junior Deputy Program (CC)
C5.
Dell Desktop Computer Purchase (CC)
C6.
Revised 2009-2014 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Consolidated Plan and 2011/2012 Annual Action Plan (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving the revised 2009-2014 Consolidated Plan.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving the 2011/12 CDBG Public Services Program funding allocation to The Angel's Depot and Vista Community Clinic.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving the 2011/12 Annual Action Plan, with the exception of the funding allocation for The Angel's Depot and Vista Community Clinic, authorizing submittal of the Plan to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development and authorizing the City Manager to approve and execute all documents related to the implementation of said plan.
C7.
Rejection of Bids for Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus (CC)
C8.
Microsoft Office 2010 License Purchase (CC)
C9.
Loan Prepayment Agreement (CC/CDC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2011- , approving a Loan Prepayment Agreement with the Community Development Commission; and
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2011- , approving a Loan Prepayment Agreement with the City of Vista.
C10.
Environmental Assessment Services Amendment (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.

City Council Resolution No. 2011- ;

2.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , for the City of Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2011- , for the South Melrose Drive Landscape Maintenance District.
